builds.default: TinyLlama default SIMS build: 840 projection, 66 attention, and 132 norm launches (1,038 in all), with device pre-attention and post-o RMSNorm, prefill and decode q/k RoPE, and prefill o/down residual adds. tools/tiny_full/attention_export.py writes these launches and capability macros (atlas-mlir: tools/tiny_full/attention_export.py:318-344); the counts are read from the qualified build's generated tiny_full_assets.h (local receipt).
builds.fast: TinyLlama fast builds: the same 1,038 launches with FP8 weights read in place (atlas-mlir: docs/tiny-fast-build.md:12) and host-only copy changes (host levels 0 to 2); op placement is identical to default.

builds.default: SmolVLA default SIMS builds (42-phase, 199-phase, and full): 2,715 projection panels (atlas-mlir: tools/smol_full_plan.py:52) and 200 attention launches (atlas-mlir: tools/smol_attention_assets.py:12), with the fc1-bias-gelu-fp8 fusion profile (atlas-mlir: docs/smol_attention_capture.md:77) on the 192 vision fc1 panels; the profile and counts are read from the qualified bundle's kernels.json (local receipt).
builds.fast: SmolVLA fast builds: the same bundle and launches with immutable linked weights (atlas-mlir: docs/smol-fast-build.md:3); op placement is identical to default.
